step: enumerate+score (full pass: Wikivoyage Wellington-region pages and Wikipedia benchmark titles from the earlier partial pass, plus DOC Wellington/Kāpiti and Wairarapa places-to-go (sitemap-derived), WellingtonNZ, Destination Wairarapa (wairarapanz.com catalogue) and Visit Kāpiti, a Wikipedia category crawl of the region, and OSM (Overpass) attractions/viewpoints/wikipedia-tagged features; blind verdicts are step 3, not done here)
scoring: views = English Wikipedia per-article views (all-access, user), 2025-10 to 2026-09 (12 months); 0 with no article or when the title only redirects to a broader article. counted_sources = visitor-oriented sources only (Wikivoyage, DOC, WellingtonNZ, Destination Wairarapa, Visit Kapiti); Wikipedia and OSM are in other_sources and not counted. Coordinates from Wikipedia, Wikivoyage listing or OSM (Overpass/Nominatim) as recorded per entry; null where no source coordinate was found.
